name: Zentra aToken burn clamp lets repayWithATokens clear debt without burning
summary: Zentra, an Aave V3 fork on Citrea, upgraded its aTokens to an implementation whose burn clamps the amount to the holder's balance instead of reverting. repayWithATokens marks debt repaid after that burn, so a caller without aTokens repays for free. The attacker borrowed ctUSD against flash-loaned USDC.e, cleared the debt this way and withdrew the collateral, then repeated it on USDC.e.
notes: Both aTokens the anchor burned from run the upgraded implementation; the earlier ones (0x777a1e50, 0xe4f00a8e, 0x2ec995d5) revert on an over-balance burn when replayed on a fork, so the defect dates from this upgrade. The reserve settings and price sources the exploit read did not change after it; later configurator events are pause toggles and an unrelated sUSN listing.

No earlier or further exploit: from the upgrade to block 13940093 the only Repay events with useATokens are the two in the anchor. Zentra has code only on Citrea, and the attacker EOA has no other Zentra activity on other chains.
Loss is the two reserves' net outflow in the anchor at DefiLlama prices; the attacker's flash-loaned USDC.e collateral and its 50 ctUSD supply were withdrawn in the same transaction and net out.
